steps.name: build-one-shot-apk
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1
git checkout -B work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1 origin/work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0bca996803c3b00930c95d7d041112d60eb1cbf2"
export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export GRADLE_OPTS="-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx384m -Dorg.gradle.workers.max=1"
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon --max-workers=1
test -s app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
echo one_shot_apk_ready=true
